title: The 5 Biggest Tech Stock Moves This Week #shorts
description: Five tech stocks moved 26% to 35% in a single day this week, counted down from #5 to #1, each with the reason behind it.

sources.title: Duolingo is up 11% after hours as its user growth speeds up again (24/7 Wall St, Nov 4 2026)
Amdocs shares crash 45% as T-Mobile dispute triggers bleak 2027 forecast (Ynet)
Kyndryl shares surge 30% on hyperscaler-related revenue growth (SiliconANGLE, Nov 4 2026)
JFrog Q3 2026 results, SEC Form 8-K exhibit

beats.say: Five tech stocks each moved more than twenty-five percent in a single day this week. Here's the countdown, from five to one.
Number five. Duolingo jumped twenty-six percent on Wednesday. Its daily users grew twenty-nine percent, faster than the quarter before.

visual.reason: Daily users +29%, faster than last quarter

beats.say: Number four. Amdocs fell thirty percent, also on Wednesday. It forecast shrinking revenue next year, as a dispute with T-Mobile, a major customer, escalated.
Number three. Kyndryl jumped thirty percent, again on Wednesday. It beat earnings estimates, and its revenue tied to cloud providers grew twenty-seven percent.
Number two. AppLovin jumped thirty-one percent on Thursday, even as the Nasdaq fell more than five percent. Its revenue grew fifty-five percent and beat its own forecast.
And number one. Software company JFrog soared thirty-five percent on Friday. Its cloud revenue grew sixty percent, and total revenue grew thirty-one percent.
Five stocks, five big surprises. Follow for one market move explained every day.
